parsed.title: Discussion on AI‑assisted job search, development tools, and code generation pitfalls

topics.title: AI‑driven job search and resume generation

claims.text: The user plans to set up an OpenClaw system to search for jobs, generate PDFs of resumes, and write cover letters.
Automation of resume generation is seen as advantageous because it allows human analysis during technical interviews.

There is a belief that the recruiter profession may become obsolete.

topics.title: Impact of AI tools on development speed and practices

claims.text: Developers can ask GPT to generate complex SQL joins, speeding up development.
AI‑generated code can introduce security and performance problems, such as overly broad queries.
Some developers view AI tools as a mainstream necessity in 2026, unlike in 2024.
The acceleration of development due to AI became significant only after 2025, despite earlier hype.

topics.title: Risks of AI‑generated code in production

claims.text: An engineer pushed code with SELECT * to production without approval after AI generation, leading to project breakage.
